inputs.question: How long must we keep invoices?

pages.https://www.ico.example.gov/guidance/dat:
Data retention guidance

Companies must keep accounting records for six years from the end of the financial year.

Personal data must not be kept longer than necessary.
pages.https://lawfirm.example.com/blog/retenti:
Retention rules explained

Most firms keep invoices for seven years to be safe.

This is not legal advice.

obligations.quote: Companies must keep accounting records for six years
